scope: one fresh reconstruction of existing TRAIN and read-only saved weights; no training/validation/formal
service_seed_formula: 611371 + 1009*wave + 37*cohort_index + model_seed; common across A/N and sampler
storage_profile: uncompressed NPZ ZIP_STORED, float64; shared corpus/cache once; lossless payload dictionary and per-request hashes/choices
N_rejection_rule: reject CV if any of six N final seed/sampler points has CV variance >= original variance; continue only the predeclared diagnostic within caps, no new training
failure_policy: any numerical/cap/provenance failure retains partials and seals this attempt; no retry after trained-model results; pure no-result launch defects require explicit new technical identity
formal_claims: none; fixed saved models cannot estimate across-training-block variance
